name: Timothy Michael DiVito

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Timothy Michael DiVito writes poetry that has appeared in magazines and anthologies including The San Fernando Poetry Journal, Möbius and Atunis Poetry Online. His collection “Words of Life”, published through Lulu in 2023, records a writing practice extending across several decades. It also identifies his earlier book “An Emotional Journey”.

“Of the Human Soul” approaches mortality through the language of embodied love. Its short, paired lines repeatedly carry a thought across a pause, moving from darkness and imagined death towards flesh, light and a new horizon. The insistence that the lovers are living bodies rather than ghosts gives the poem its centre: intimacy becomes an answer to the despair from which they have emerged.
